units: <cite ref="Pesachim 76a:15">Pes. 76ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>אית ביה פ׳</he> if there are splits (in the crusty surface of the roast); <cite ref="Chullin 112a:6">Ḥull. 112ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 33b:9">Sabb. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>הוו ביה פ׳ בגופיה</he> had cuts in his skin (from living in a cave).
<cite ref="Moed Katan 3a:11">M. Kat. 3ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Sukkah 44b:7">Succ. 44ᵇ</cite> <he>סתומי פ׳</he> to close up fissures in the soil which covers the roots.
